gauges.name: Neches River at Evadale
gauges.note: Below both Sam Rayburn and B. A. Steinhagen. Stage is partly a reservoir-release signal, not pure drought.
gauges.stage_units: metres above the gauge datum, NOT above sea level

gauges.name: Neches River near Rockland
gauges.note: Above Steinhagen. Unregulated; one of the two reference gauges that define low-flow dates.
gauges.stage_units: metres above the gauge datum, NOT above sea level

gauges.name: Angelina River near Alto
gauges.note: Above Sam Rayburn. Unregulated. Biggest drought swing in the record: 3.2 m below the growing-season median in 2011.
gauges.stage_units: metres above the gauge datum, NOT above sea level

gauges.name: Neches River near Town Bluff
gauges.note: At the B. A. Steinhagen dam. Stage is set by dam operation. Included for contrast, not for drought.
gauges.stage_units: metres above the gauge datum, NOT above sea level
